title: People & HR
summary: Keep employee records, company structure, time off and policies in one place.
tagline: One home for your people and how your company is organised.
intro: OnCulture keeps your employee records, company structure and everyday HR admin together, so your team spends less time chasing information and more time on people.

features.title: Employee profiles
features.description: Personal, job and contact details, emergency contacts and documents for every employee.

features.title: Org chart and structure
features.description: Set up departments, branches, job roles and job levels, and see how everyone fits together.

features.title: Custom fields
features.description: Capture the extra employee information that matters to your company.

features.title: CSV import
features.description: Bring your whole team into OnCulture at once from a spreadsheet.

features.title: Time off
features.description: Create leave types and policies, track balances as they accrue, and let employees request time off.

features.title: Approval workflows
features.description: Route time-off requests through the right approvers, one step after another or in parallel.

features.title: Company policies
features.description: Publish policy documents with their effective dates so everyone can find the latest version.

title: Performance
summary: Run review cycles, set goals and connect day-to-day work to results.
tagline: Clear goals, fair reviews and work that adds up.
intro: Give every employee clear goals and regular, structured feedback. OnCulture runs your review cycles and links everyday work to the goals it moves forward.

features.title: Review cycles
features.description: Run cycles for the whole company or selected employees, with approvers and clear timelines.

features.title: Goals and milestones
features.description: Set goals, break them into milestones, and approve and track them through to completion.

features.title: Multi-perspective reviews
features.description: Collect self, manager, peer and direct-report reviews in a single cycle.

features.title: Flexible reviewers
features.description: Choose who reviews each person: their line manager, department lead, branch lead or a specific colleague.

features.title: Question bank and ratings
features.description: Reuse review questions across cycles and rate performance consistently.

features.title: Sum-Ups linked to goals
features.description: Connect Team Sum-Up updates to goals so progress is visible without extra reporting.

title: Engagement & Recognition
summary: Keep teams connected, recognise great work and hear what your people think.
tagline: Keep teams connected and recognise the behaviours you want to see.
intro: Culture is built in small, regular moments. OnCulture gives your teams simple rituals for staying aligned, celebrating each other and speaking up.

features.title: Team Sum-Up
features.description: Regular updates on what people worked on, what is next and what is blocking them.

features.title: Shout Out
features.description: Celebrate colleagues for stand-out work and tie each shout-out to a company value.

features.title: Value Star
features.description: Hold regular team votes to recognise the colleagues who best exemplify your company values.

features.title: Feedback Hub
features.description: Give employees a safe channel to raise complaints and share suggestions.

features.title: Announcements and company feed
features.description: Share news company-wide, collect acknowledgements, and let people react and comment.

features.title: Catch-ups
features.description: Never miss a birthday, work anniversary or public holiday.

title: Learning
summary: A wide catalogue of culture courses, with progress tracking and certificates.
tagline: Courses that build healthier, more productive workplaces.
intro: Develop your people with a wide catalogue of culture courses on leadership, teamwork, communication and workplace safety. Short courses fit into one sitting, and full courses come with modules and quizzes.

features.title: Course catalogue
features.description: Full and short courses on leadership, teams and performance, culture and engagement, workplace safety, and career and communication.

features.title: Assign courses
features.description: Enrol your whole company or selected employees in the courses that matter to you.

features.title: Modules and quizzes
features.description: Bite-sized lessons with quizzes that check understanding as people learn.

features.title: Progress tracking
features.description: See who has started, who is in progress and who has completed each course.

features.title: Certificates
features.description: Employees receive a certificate when they complete a course.
